hero.subtitle: US products for international buyers, delivered to your port

overview.label: WHO WE ARE
overview.p1: KG Industries is a US trading and sourcing company. We give international buyers access to US products that manufacturers do not export directly.
overview.p2: Many US manufacturers sell only through domestic distributors, or have no export function at all. Overseas buyers end up paying through two or three regional agents, or cannot buy at all. We purchase in the United States as the domestic buyer, handle the export ourselves, and deliver to your port.
overview.p3: We work with procurement teams, importers, distributors, and operators across the Gulf, the Middle East and North Africa, the Caucasus, Central Asia, Europe, and Latin America.

hero.title: How It Works
hero.subtitle: From your RFQ to delivery at your port on CIP or CIF terms.

steps.title: Send your RFQ
steps.text: Product or item numbers, specification, quantity, destination port or city, and target delivery window. If you have a current supplier price, include it. It lets us tell you quickly whether we can compete.

steps.title: We confirm scope
steps.text: We confirm specification, quantities, packaging, and your import document requirements before quoting. No guesswork on your behalf.

steps.title: We source at the factory
steps.text: We buy from the US manufacturer or channel as the domestic purchaser, at ex-works (EXW) or FCA terms.

steps.title: You receive a landed quote
steps.text: Line-item pricing delivered CIP or CIF to your named port, with freight and insurance included, a stated expiry date, and a clear list of exclusions.

steps.title: Proforma invoice and payment
steps.text: Once you confirm, we issue a proforma invoice with the agreed Incoterm, payment terms, and shipment schedule.

steps.title: Production, consolidation, and export
steps.text: We collect goods, consolidate into your container, and file the US export declaration. We prepare the commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin, plus any product certificates your market requires.
steps.who: KG acts as the US exporter.

steps.title: Shipment and insurance
steps.text: We book ocean freight to your port and insure the cargo. You receive tracking and a copy of the shipping documents at departure.

steps.title: Arrival and clearance
steps.text: You or your agent clear customs as importer of record and pay local duties and taxes. Destination terminal charges and inland delivery are on your side unless your quote says otherwise.
steps.who: You clear and receive the goods.

incoterms.title: CIP vs CIF

items.text: Used for containerized cargo. We pay carriage and insurance to your named place. Insurance is all-risks cover (Institute Cargo Clauses A) under Incoterms 2020.
Sea and port-to-port only. We pay freight and insurance to your named port. Minimum insurance cover is Institute Cargo Clauses C under Incoterms 2020, unless agreed higher.

incoterms.risk: Under both terms, risk passes to the buyer when goods are handed to the carrier or loaded on board at origin, not on arrival. That is why insurance is included.
incoterms.other: Other terms (FCA, DAP) available on request.
